result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane urban arterial with a marked high-visibility crosswalk at a signalized intersection. While sidewalks and crossing markings are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a pedestrian refuge island or curb extensions increase exposure to high-volume traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, which can endanger pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.
